formula: sum((A-R)*(D-R))/sum((D-R)^2), on final 16x3 normalized action XYZ; plotted percent = 100*fraction. Each seed has its own paired R=x15 and D=x06 axis. 0 is R and 100 is D along that axis. Orthogonal differences are not represented; negative and >100 values are valid. Percent is not milk probability, target selection or grasp success.
